openIssues.limitations: Issue and PR collections are live API observations gathered shortly after the stated snapshot anchor, not a historical point-in-time database. A PR without an issue reference may be missed; titles/bodies and selected discussions were searched, but every unreferenced implementation and every older closed PR were not re-audited. GitHub timeline absence alone was not treated as proof. Correspondence, including a partial or closed-unmerged PR, is distinct from a verified fix or currently active work.
